tagline: Leadership, life, and stress management for women who are managing everything anyway.
audience: Perimenopausal women with ADHD who lead teams, run households, and are ready to build something for themselves.

tracks.name: Build With Claude
tracks.description: A hands-on workgroup teaching foundational tech skills using Claude as the guide — starting with static pages, moving to local projects, and ending with small working agents. No CS degree required, no gatekeeping, no pretending the fog doesn't happen.

modules.title: HTML Basics
modules.summary: Build your first web page from scratch. Learn what HTML actually is, why it's not scary, and how to see your own words become a real page in a browser.
outcomes: Understand tags, structure, and how a browser reads a page
Build a personal one-page site with headings, text, links, and an image
Use Claude to explain, debug, and extend your own HTML

modules.title: Localhost Projects
modules.summary: Take your HTML off the page and onto your own machine. Learn what 'running something locally' actually means, and why it's the bridge between a static page and a real app.
outcomes: Set up a local development environment without fear
Run and preview a project on localhost
Understand the difference between a file you open and a server you run

modules.title: Before Apps
modules.summary: The missing middle step between 'I made a webpage' and 'I built an app.' Small interactive projects that build real confidence before tackling something bigger.
outcomes: Add basic interactivity to a page
Understand what separates a webpage from an application
Build one small interactive project end-to-end

modules.title: Building Mini Claude Agents
modules.summary: Use Claude's own tools to build a small personal agent — something that does one real task for you, on repeat, without you having to ask every time.
outcomes: Understand what an 'agent' actually is versus a chatbot
Build one small working agent solving a real personal problem
Know enough to keep building after the workgroup ends
